name: When is the best time to start thinking about senior home modifications?

mainEntity.name: When is the best time to start thinking about senior home modifications?

acceptedAnswer.text: The best time to consider senior home modifications is proactively, before an immediate need or incident arises. Many families begin planning when a senior expresses a desire to age in place, or when subtle changes in mobility or health become apparent. Addressing modifications early allows for thoughtful planning, budgeting, and execution without urgency, ensuring the home is safe and comfortable well in advance. It's often easier to make changes when they are not a response to a crisis.
acceptedAnswer.description: The best time is proactively, before an immediate need, allowing for thoughtful planning and execution to ensure safety and comfort.
